limitations.note: The patch correctly made the counter edge-triggered but also removed the `ready_b` guard, so the first accepted byte of a group overwrites `data_out` when `ready_b` is low instead of being added to it as in the reference.

The scoreboard cleared its running sum after every group regardless of `ready_b`, so the stall cases validated the rewritten behavior rather than checking whether the original accumulator behavior was preserved.
